name: El Centro De La Raza
requirements: Please bring photo ID
commodityDistribution: Must meet income requirements and live within the 98108, 98118, or 98144 zip codes.

name: Asian Counseling and Referral Services Food Bank
requirements: Please bring photo ID
additionalInformation: The Asian Counseling & Referral Service (ACRS) Food Bank regularly distributes foods for Asian and Pacific Islander diets.

name: Ballard Food Bank
requirements: Please bring a photo I.D. and a current proof of address (a piece of mail you've received within the past 30 days) for yourself and others living in your household (school or medical records for children living with you) demonstrating you live in our geographic area.
commodityDistribution: Yes to limited area - call for more information

name: Blessed Sacrament Food Bank
areaServed: Parts of zip codes 98105, 98103, 98115 (all partial; serves the parish boundary)
requirements: Live within the parish boundary or be a registered parishioner. Please present ID for all in household and proof of address.
additionalInformation: Blessed Sacrament Food Bank has served the University District for over 47 years. We also serve a four-course meal each Sunday 12:00pm - 2:00pm to which all are welcome. We have a shoe bank quarterly during food bank and our Sunday meal. We distribute toiletries regularly. Through our St. Vincent de Paul Conference we serve all in need of assistance within our parish boundaries or who are registered parishioners.

name: Byrd Barr Place Food Bank
requirements: None.
commodityDistribution: Zip codes 98102, 98112, 98122. Please bring a picture ID, utility or medical bill, or other printed document to verify your address.
additionalInformation: Home Delivery: For elderly and verifiably homebound individuals. In order to receive this service you must live within 98112, 98122, or 98102. If you or someone you know would benefit from having a food bag delivered one day per week, please call (206) 812-4970.
homeDelivery: Available for elderly and homebound individuals in 98112, 98122, 98102.

name: Cherry Street Food Bank
distributionHours: Thursday: 9:00am - 12:00pm, Baby Day (children under 5 & their families only)
requirements: Proof of address, income, or need is never required. Clients are asked only for last name and total number of people in the family (number of family members who are infants, children, adults, or seniors). The presence of a child or proof of child's age (WIC card, birth certificate, immunization record) is required to receive Baby Day items.

name: FamilyWorks - Wallingford Food Bank
requirements: First-time customers are asked to bring a photo ID and proof of address.
commodityDistribution: Must reside in Wallingford Food Bank zip codes (98103 only). 3rd Saturday of the month: 10:00am - 12:00pm.
homeDelivery: Must reside in Wallingford Food Bank zip codes (98103, 98107, 98115, 98117, 98133, 98177). Eligibility determined by difficulty in leaving home due to physical disability or incapacity.
additionalInformation: FamilyWorks Resource Center is a warm and inviting place where families and individuals are welcomed to participate in programs designed to support a nurturing and vibrant community. Programs include Parent/Child Playgroups, Single Parent Activities, Teen Parent Program, Parenting Classes, Life Skills Development, Individual and Family Advocacy, and WIC.

name: FamilyWorks - Greenwood Food Bank
requirements: First-time customers are asked to bring a photo ID and proof of address.
additionalInformation: The Greenwood Food Bank provides weekly groceries to people in need of food. It is a partnership between The Salvation Army and FamilyWorks that opened on April 20, 2016.

name: Giving Room Food Bank @ Epic Life Church
requirements: Bring your own bag or box!

name: Immanuel Community Services Food Bank
additionalInformation: Hygiene Center available for visitors to wash clothes, take a shower, and spend a few hours in a warm, safe and dry environment. Open weekdays 8:00am - 2:00pm.
Recovery Program Shelter available for adult men working to overcome addiction.
Community Lunch available on the last Sunday of every month at noon (Jan-May & Sept-Dec) and at 11:00am (Jun-Aug).

name: Jewish Family Service
homeDelivery: Sunday - Monday, 9:00am - 5:00pm. Central Seattle. Clients must be unable to travel to the food bank due to age or disability.
additionalInformation: Resource and referrals with case manager
Cooking and nutrition classes and information
Both adult and baby diapers available (first-time users must present birth certificate for each child)
No-cook bags for clients without cooking facilities

name: North Helpline - Lake City Food Bank
areaServed: 98115, 98125, 98133, 98155, 98177, 98011, and 98028. We do not turn anyone away who comes to us for food.
requirements: Clients need to register for a food bank card. All clients can receive food once each week during distribution hours. Visit http://www.northhelpline.org/get-help/food-bank/ for registration info.
commodityDistribution: For those living in zip code 98125 only. Wednesdays: 10:00am - 1:00pm, Thursdays: 4:30pm - 6:30pm, Saturdays: 10:00am - 1:00pm
homeDelivery: Serves homebound adults in zip codes 98115, 98125, 98133, 98155, 98177.

name: North Helpline - Bitter Lake Food Bank
areaServed: 98115, 98125, 98133, 98155, 98177, 98011, and 98028. We do not turn anyone away who comes to us for food.
requirements: Clients need to register for a food bank card. All clients can receive food once each week during distribution hours.
additionalInformation: Since July 1, 2017, North Helpline operates a second food bank in the Bitter Lake neighborhood. The food bank is open every Saturday.

name: Paradise of Praise
requirements: One visit per week.

name: Phinney Ridge Food Bank
additionalInformation: Anyone in need can call (206) 784-7964 on Monday between 1:00 and 3:00 p.m. to make an appointment. Walk-ups are welcome. The food bank stocks a variety of food and personal care products: low-sodium offerings, baby food, ethnic foods, pet food, and food designed for people who are homeless.

name: Pike Market Food Bank
requirements: Must live in above zip code areas. May only visit once per week.
commodityDistribution: No separate commodity day. Commodities available Tuesdays and Thursdays during regular food bank hours.
homeDelivery: Serves zip codes 98101, 98104, 98121. Home delivery is intended for people who otherwise cannot access our food bank due to physical and/or mental limitations and is by referral of a health or housing professional only.

name: Providence Regina House
requirements: Proof of area residency.

name: Puget Sound Labor Agency
requirements: Most of our clientele are at or below 200% of federal poverty level but it is not required - no one is turned away. Must reside in one of our service zip codes to receive commodities.
additionalInformation: Hygiene products distribution on the first two Fridays of every month
Diabetes/blood pressure screening twice a year
Cellphone distribution last two Fridays of October and November every year

name: Queen Anne Food Bank at Sacred Heart
requirements: Please provide proof of current address, such as a utility bill or rent receipt.
additionalInformation: Meal Program - Monday-Thursday 8:30am - 11:30am. No eligibility requirements.
Pack Program - Fridays 9:00am - 11:00am. No eligibility requirements. Includes lunch and no-cook items.
Farm Fresh Market - Fridays 11:00am - 12:30pm, June - October. No eligibility requirements.

name: Rainier Valley Food Bank
requirements: Government-issued ID requested but not required.
commodityDistribution: Must reside in zip codes 98118 or 98178.
homeDelivery: Serves Southeast Seattle (primarily). Completed application form with physician's signature required.
additionalInformation: To-go bags for individuals and families without cooking facilities, five days a week (during office hours)
Diapers distributed four days per month - 45 diapers per child per month (first-time users must present birth certificate for each child)

name: Salvation Army Food Bank
requirements: Must express a need, live within our service area, and present picture ID for household members (medical cards, SS cards, or paperwork showing household members for kids) each visit. Those without ID or outside our service area are eligible for bread/produce only.
additionalInformation: Hygiene kits for those experiencing homelessness

name: Seattle Indian Center Food Bank
requirements: Photo I.D.

name: St. Vincent de Paul Food Bank
requirements: Photo ID recommended but not required.
additionalInformation: Case management by appointment through Help Line only. Help Line: 206-767-6449
Clothing bank and health assessments during all food distribution hours
Free clothing, first come first served
Free haircuts for those experiencing homelessness (Fridays)

name: The Food Bank @ St. Mary's
areaServed: Seattle residents only for Baby Corner and protein (meat & eggs). No one is turned away for other items.
requirements: Photo ID recommended but not required.
commodityDistribution: Must live in the east side of 98144 to qualify. Same hours as regular distribution.
homeDelivery: Seattle residents who live within a three-mile radius of the food bank may qualify. This program serves the elderly, disabled, and sick who are unable to get to the food bank and have no one available to come for them. One must apply and be approved. Deliveries Wednesdays 9:00am - 5:00pm.

name: University District Food Bank
requirements: Proof of address, I.D.
commodityDistribution: Commodities given out with regular food distribution to zip codes 98105, 98115, 98125 only.
homeDelivery: Must live within zip codes 98102, 98103, 98105, 98115, 98125, or 98112.

name: West Seattle Food Bank
requirements: We ask families to provide photo identification and proof of address (such as a recent piece of mail with a West Seattle zip code) on their first visit.
homeDelivery: Serves West Seattle area homebound and disabled.
additionalInformation: Weekend food for students in need in Seattle Public Schools

name: White Center Food Bank
areaServed: Residents in the community bordered by SW Myrtle St (to the north, in West Seattle) to 140th St SW (to the south, in Burien) between Puget Sound and HWY 509.
requirements: Visits by appointment only. Must bring proof of address and I.D. Three visits per month.
homeDelivery: Serves White Center area homebound and disabled.

name: YWCA Central Area Food Bank
requirements: Visits by appointment only. Must bring proof of address and I.D. Three visits per month.
commodityDistribution: Must live within zip codes 98122, 98121, or 98118.
